label: Summarize paper
description: Run a dedicated, isolated summary writer for one ready paper and wait for its saved version. Use this for missing paper summaries instead of drafting through a general research worker. Summary jobs are serialized, use their own model-aware context, and default to reasoning disabled where supported. Wait for each receipt before starting the next paper. Reviewed summaries require complete source coverage; a partial or overview receipt does not satisfy a full review. Read source passages and save durable research notes separately.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact ID of one already ingested local paper.
parameter_descriptions.mode: reviewed for a citation-grounded full review; overview only when the user requests a quick, explicitly limited orientation.
parameter_descriptions.reasoning_effort: Null uses the dedicated writer's nonthinking default where supported. Set a supported explicit effort only when the user explicitly requests reasoning for summary writing; do not inherit the research agent's reasoning setting. If an explicit effort is rejected, report the incompatibility rather than silently retrying with a different effort.
